rows.grounds: compound expressing totality of sins; ablative marks separation or source of liberation
past passive participle indicating complete release; masculine form as given
compound qualifying a woman afflicted with severe barrenness
present verb expressing the resulting capacity to bear offspring

items.question: What transformative result does complete freedom from all sins bring to a greatly barren woman?
premises: Complete freedom from all sins can be attained.
A greatly barren woman may become completely freed from all sins.
Such liberation removes the condition preventing childbirth.
items.inference: Therefore, a greatly barren woman gives birth after being completely freed from all sins.
uncertainties: The masculine form vinirmuktaḥ occurs with the feminine subject mahā+bandhyā; agreement is taken as contextual.
items.plain_english: Completely freed from all sins, even a greatly barren woman gives birth.
